name: Philosopher
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. If this character is in play, they are drunk.
wakes: Each night until the ability is used; afterwards wakes when the gained character would.
interaction: Shakes head or points to a Townsfolk or Outsider icon. Not in play: token swapped for that character with the Is the Philosopher reminder. In play: that player gets the Drunk reminder.
drunk_or_poisoned: Choosing while drunk or poisoned spends the once-per-game ability with no effect (no ability gained, nobody drunk). If a Philosopher who gained an in-play ability becomes drunk, poisoned or dies, the original player sobers.

jinxes.text: If the Philosopher gains the Bounty Hunter ability, a Townsfolk might turn evil.

rulings.text: Gains the ability but does not become the character; acts when that character acts, and a first-night-only ability is used the same night it is chosen.
Copying an in-play Artist drunks the real Artist; if the Philosopher dies or becomes drunk or poisoned, the Artist sobers.
If the ability is regained via Bone Collector or doubled via Barista, the Philosopher may choose a new or the same ability.
Abilities that work while dead (Klutz) still work for a dead Philosopher.
Night order numbers are from bra1n/townsquare src/roles.json (develop branch), not the botc-release list.

test_scenarios.name: copy in-play character
test_scenarios.setup: 5 players: seat 0 Philosopher, 1 Empath, 2 Chef, 3 Poisoner, 4 Imp
test_scenarios.expected: Empath gets the Drunk reminder; Philosopher gets Empath info from that night on

test_scenarios.name: copy not-in-play character
test_scenarios.expected: Token becomes Clockmaker with Is the Philosopher; learns the Clockmaker number on night 1

test_scenarios.name: poisoned when choosing
test_scenarios.expected: Ability spent, Empath not drunk, Philosopher gains nothing
